tool_input.command:
F=$PWD; SP=$F/plugins/system-spec-harness; D=$F/system-spec
python3 -B $SP/scripts/validate-coverage-matrix.py --matrix $D/spec-state.json --require-complete --require-basis --require-foundation; echo cov=$?
python3 -B $SP/scripts/validate-source-citation.py --targets $D/spec-state.json --references $D/fetched-references.json --state $D/spec-state.json --repo-root $F; echo cite=$?
python3 -B $F/plugins/dev-graph/scripts/validate-graph-schema.py --graph $F/.dev-graph/state/graph.json --repo-root $F --strict-artifact-readiness >/dev/null; echo schema=$?
python3 -B $SP/scripts/validate-design-knowledge-refs.py --matrix $D/spec-state.json --repo-root $F; echo dkr=$?
python3 -B $SP/skills/assign-system-spec-completeness-evaluator/scripts/aggregate-completeness.py --report $F/eval-log/system-spec-completeness-report.json --spec-dir $D --session 7e088399-8515-4f72-b8c8-7b1f9861cc44 | tail -c 1500; echo agg=$?
shasum -a 256 $D/*.md $D/spec-state.json $D/fetched-references.json eval-log/system-spec-completeness-report.json eval-log/hearing-audit.json
python3 -c "
import json;r=json.load(open('eval-log/system-spec-completeness-report.json'));print('spec_dir',repr(r['spec_dir']),'verdict',r['verdict']);print({k:v.get('verdict') for k,v in r['aspects'].items()} if isinstance(r['aspects'],dict) else r['aspects'][:1]);print(json.dumps(r['audit_delegations'],ensure_ascii=False)[:1500])
s=json.load(open('system-spec/spec-state.json'));print(s['hearing_progress'],[t['target_id'] for t in s['targets']],[(k['id'],k.get('status')) for k in s.get('knowledge_candidates',[])])
f=json.load(open('system-spec/fetched-references.json'));print([x['target_id'] for x in f['references']])
"
tool_input.description: Re-run gates and verify report independently
